services.name: Stansbury Golf Course
services.desc: When the Stansbury Golf Course opened in 1972, it was one of the premier golf courses in Utah. Its designer was William Henrichsen Neff. With water in play on 16 of the 18 holes, the course was considered challenging enough for the Utah Open, which was held here in the past. Stansbury Service Agency owns and operates the golf course, which is located at 1 Clubhouse Drive in Stansbury Park. The course offers terrific views, a pro shop, a putting green, a driving range, and a 40 x 40 pavilion for tournaments.
